reviews.title: You will love this rug!
reviews.body: The colors are vibrant and very pretty! I love the color it brings to our mostly brown room. It's very soft, thin, and has a non slip backing. I got the 8x10 and it's the perfect size. Great rug at a great price! Now let's just pray my dog doesn't immediately puke on it. 😂😂😂

reviews.author: Jludeau

reviews.title: THIS WILL WORK JUST FINE FOR ME!
reviews.body: Not necessarily what I expected in terms of textured but it is very nice and, for my needs (just an accent, a touch of reddish color in an otherwise overwhelming tan pine floor and walls and ceiling)...perfect. As I said before, I expected a rougher surface texture--as one would for any rug. This one has a velvety quality to it, pretty soft and, I suspect, not designed for moderate traffic, considering it is on the thin side. It is washable. It is light. It is easy to move around or to store somewhere if needed. I certainly appreciate the non-slip rubber bottom surface--otherwise, it would be an accident waiting to happen. So, yes, I am pleased with the purchase. I am on a budget and this area rug saved me a lot of unnecessary and frustrating driving around looking for something to fit my needs.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on April 18, 2026

reviews.title: Great product!
reviews.body: Absolutely love this rug it seems to be made right and not all cheap looking. We like its easily washable. It's feels so good on your feet. Saw alot of reviews talking about it being folded up within the first day all the crease marks have gone away you can't even see where it was folded up. All in all if your looking for rug at a decent price get this one you won't regret it!

reviews.author: Krystal

reviews.title: Not plush. Low pile. Perfect for my robot vacuum.
reviews.body: I got the 8x10 size, and it is the perfect fit for my space. It matches my decor beautifully and really tied my living room together. The colors look just like the photos and gave my room the warm, cozy vibe I was going for.I will say, when I first opened the package, I was a little turned off because I expected it to be more plush based on the listing photos. At first glance, it looked flatter than I anticipated, but I quickly realized the “texture” I thought I saw in the photos is actually part of the artwork/design.That said, I’m genuinely not disappointed at all because this rug is surprisingly SOFT. I literally keep rubbing my feet on it every time I walk by. It feels great underfoot and ended up exceeding my expectations in a different way.For the price, I think this rug elevated my entire room and made the space feel much more put together. I’m really happy with my purchase.(And it looks even better in person 😍)
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on May 23, 2026

reviews.title: Living room rug
reviews.body: This is the most beautiful rug and it is thin and folds easy which I love a thin rug because the vacuum runs over it very easily. I love the terra-cotta color. It is exactly what I expected after viewing the photos on Amazon. It took no time to flatten out and this is an 8 x 10 for only $100 and you cannot beat that it also feels so nice to walk on. It’s not rough.

reviews.title: Great boho type design
reviews.body: Very soft, super thin rug!  Love the design but it should not be folded when stored and mailed as it produces lines on the surface that are lighter and distract from the design.  The manufacturer should roll this product and send it by mailing tube to preserve the original surface.

reviews.author: Steve M.

features: Ultra Soft: The 2x3 area rugs are made of reinforced faux wool, it is much more soft and comfortable. Machine made weave and high density stitched edge makes the rug can prevent from scratching and indoor high traffic.

Pet Friendly & Non Slip: No shedding and low pile fiber is healthy , and it is friendly to pets. The area rug adopts TPR backing, which is a safer and more friendly non-slip material. Which can effectively prevent from slipping or falling.

Machine Washable: The rug is machine washable, machine wash or hand wash are all available. We suggest to wash it in cold water. Vacuum or robot vacuum cleaner are all recommend. You can spot clean the rug with a rag for small stain. No bleach and no high temperature ironing.

Easy Care: Avoid direct expose to sunlight. It can keep the bright color with you for a longer time. The rugs may fold into a small package during the process of transportation, rugs may have slight creases upon received. Unroll the carpet for a few days and the wrinkles will disappear. It is recommended to flatten the carpet with heavy books, furniture or other heavy object. Apply carpet tape. Low-temperature ironing is also available.

Tribal Series and Western Style: The Rug patterns feature printed designs that blend tribal and western elements, adding a touch of vintage artistry to your home. The carpets are available in a variety of colors and sizes to suit different living spaces. They are ideal for entryways, foyers, hallways, kitchens, living rooms, dining rooms, and other high-traffic indoor areas. The carpet surface is Water Repellent, and stain-resistant, making it easy to clean.
